title: Sinners
text: A thrilling exploration of morality and culture using the age old tale of vampires. Sinners manages to blend horror and drama in a way that keeps you on the edge of your seat. The film gives its supernatural story a powerful emotional foundation through its characters and conflicts. It also makes you think about the nature of good and evil long after the credits roll.

title: Dog Day Afternoon
text: An amazing performance by Al Pacino anchors this true story of a bank robbery gone wrong. This movie is a wild ride from start to finish, filled with tension and unexpected humor. Beneath the chaos, the characters are given surprising warmth and vulnerability. It also has a lot of heart behind its queer representation.

title: Five Nights at Freddy's 2
text: This is a great improvement from the first movie. The scares are better executed, with stronger pacing and more effective tension. The plot also includes more thoughtful nods to the games without losing focus on the story. It is definitely a must-watch for fans of the franchise.

title: Candyman
text: Candyman is a haunting blend of urban legend and social commentary. Its atmosphere is thick with dread, turning familiar spaces into something deeply unsettling. The story uses its supernatural mystery to explore history, prejudice, and the stories people choose to believe. Sharp storytelling and unforgettable imagery make it a standout in modern horror.

title: Frankenstein
text: Frankenstein is a timeless tale of creation and consequence. Its central conflict remains compelling because it treats the monster as more than a simple figure of fear. The story asks difficult questions about humanity, responsibility, and the limits of ambition. It remains a powerful reflection on the fear of the unknown.

title: GoodFellas
text: GoodFellas is a gripping and stylish look into the world of organized crime. Its fast pace pulls you into the glamour and danger of the characters' lifestyle. The film balances intensity and dark humor without softening the consequences of their choices. Unforgettable performances make it a crime classic few films can match.

title: The Godfather
text: The Godfather is a masterclass in storytelling and character development. Every quiet conversation carries the weight of family history and political power. The film shows how loyalty can become both a source of strength and a dangerous obligation. It weaves these ideas into one of the most iconic crime sagas ever made.

title: Lake Mungo
text: Lake Mungo is a slow-burning and deeply unsettling mockumentary that lingers long after it ends. Its restrained presentation makes every silence and ordinary detail feel suspicious. The film builds fear through grief, memory, and the possibility that something has been missed. It excels at quiet horror and emotional depth.

title: The Substance
text: The Substance is a bold and provocative body-horror drama about identity, ambition, and the cost of reinvention. Its striking visual style turns the characters' desires into something grotesque and impossible to ignore. The escalating horror feels both surreal and uncomfortably familiar. Disturbing and stylish, it is impossible to look away from.

title: The Terminator
text: The Terminator is a relentless sci-fi thriller that helped redefine the genre. Its chase sequences maintain a sense of pressure from beginning to end. Alongside the action, the film develops a surprisingly emotional connection between its central characters. That balance of tension and heart makes it an enduring classic.
